name: workman
description: Six skills for running coding agents against WorkState, the self-hosted work tracker. plan — turn a request into a run with units, done-criteria, verify commands, rules and assumptions, then stop for approval. orchestrate — execute one plan too large for a context window by delegating every task to subagents and verifying each result. controller — run a queue of independent units, one nested Claude each: brief, steer, verify, land and record. agents — launch, address, watch and stop nested Claude sessions over a READY/BLOCKED/DONE protocol (ships the agents MCP server). setup — install, start, register and back up the WorkState server. import — bring a repo's existing plans, TODOs and ADRs into WorkState, keeping only what is still true.
